text: P0 CATALOG PERFORMANCE - ROOT CAUSE FOUND, AND THE 3-QUERY FIX DOES NOT COVER THE EARLY ACCESS STOREFRONT. This answers the founder's 30-60s mobile catalog directly. THE FAN-OUT IS STILL LIVE ON /api/research/early-access/catalog. Path: register.ts -> createEarlyAccessCatalogSourceForDeployment -> createProductionEarlyAccessCatalogSource -> createProductionProductControlReader() -> LiveProductControlReader.readCatalog() in server/research/catalog/product-control-reader.ts:146. THE ARITHMETIC, exact: SupabaseProductAdminRepository.get() at product-admin-production.ts:380 issues 1 product query plus a Promise.all of 6 (variants, prices, media, content, history, inputs) = 7 queries per product. readStableDetail at product-control-reader.ts:126 calls get() TWICE per product - a deliberate double-read stability check comparing detailSnapshotToken - so 14 QUERIES PER PRODUCT. readCatalog then does Promise.all over every published product, plus two repository.list() calls (3 queries each). At ~236 published products that is 236 x 14 + 6 = ~3,310, which is the '3,306 queries per request' figure almost exactly. So the number in that commit title is THIS function. WHY THE FIX MISSED IT: 2e1662b wired BulkCatalogPricingSource into server/index.ts:640 as masterOfferingCatalogPricingSource - the MASTER-OFFERINGS catalog. The Early Access customer catalog does not go through it; it goes through LiveProductControlReader, which is untouched. grep confirms bulk-catalog-pricing-source has exactly one non-test caller: server/index.ts. So the customer-facing storefront the founder is complaining about never got the fast path. NOT MY PATHS - NOT FIXING IT. server/research/catalog/** is claude-fable-s7's CATALOG-ACTION-UNIFICATION lease, and product-admin-production.ts is products-diagnostics. Reporting rather than crossing a lease. s7 messaged in parallel. LIKELY SHAPE OF THE FIX (s7's call, not mine): repository.listForPricing() at product-admin-production.ts:324 ALREADY does the bulk read - one variants query plus one prices query alongside the product list. readCatalog needs an equivalent bulk detail path rather than N x get(). The double-read stability check is the harder part: it exists to avoid serving a torn snapshot, so it cannot simply be deleted - it needs to become one bulk read repeated once, not 2N single reads. That keeps the guarantee at 6 queries instead of 14N. I COULD NOT MEASURE IT LIVE. The only running server is s9-conversion-qa's Vite DEV server on 5199, which serves hundreds of unbundled modules and answers /api/research/early-access/catalog with 503 because it has no Supabase credentials. Nobody should quote a timing from that server - dev-mode module loading is not production, and the catalog endpoint is not even answering. Real numbers need a production build with credentials, which I do not have. PRODUCTION MUTATED: NO.
